gbm_population_evidence.quote: IDH wildtype gliomas (molecularly defined high grade glioma or molecularly defined glioblastoma

candidate_evidence.quote: This phase II trial studies how well temozolomide and radiation therapy work in treating patients with IDH wildtype historically lower grade gliomas or non-histological molecular glioblastomas.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Prior chemotherapy or radiotherapy for any brain tumor

role_evidence.quote: Beginning 28 days after the last dose of radiation therapy, patients receive temozolomide PO for 12 months in the absence of disease progression or unacceptable toxicity.

source_quote.quote: IDH wildtype gliomas (molecularly defined high grade glioma or molecularly defined glioblastoma

coder_notes: Temozolomide (established GBM therapy) with radiotherapy is tested in a new setting (IDH-wildtype historically lower-grade gliomas) with 12 months of adjuvant temozolomide, so coded established_therapy_experiment; the stated investigational variable is radiotherapy dose and volume. Either this or soc_backbone leaves no candidate. Radiotherapy is not an agent.
